title: Courier Crisis: The Saga of the Modern Fatalist
native_title: クーリエ・クライシス
overview:
Find the recipient and deliver the mail!

Uses real MTB and BMX bikes!

Land your tricks!

Ride as a bicycle courier racing the clock through the streets of a sprawling city. Pick up packages, track down each recipient and hand over the delivery before time runs out, weaving around traffic and pedestrians along the way. Pull off jumps and tricks to get past obstacles, and spend the money you earn on new bikes.

- Deliver a set number of packages in each stage against a time limit
- City districts include the Civic Center, China Town, the Waterfront, Skid Row and the Industrial Zone
- Licensed mountain bikes and BMX bikes from GT Bicycles

受取人を捜してメールを届けろ！

実在のMTB、BMXを使用！

トリックを決めろ！
